signal: PandaDoc named a new CEO in January 2026, crossed $100M ARR, and shipped AI data extraction and end-to-end agreement workflow advances.

email.body1:
Christine, saw PandaDoc named a new CEO and is lining up major automation and AI launches after crossing $100M ARR.

A leadership shift plus an aggressive roadmap usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christine, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

With a new CEO, board expectations on enterprise pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Christine, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to other document automation vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Christine, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A leadership transition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise SaaS motion? I'll tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
